defect: FIFO state crosses between independently reset write, pointer-synchronizer and data registers
rationale: wr_ptr_q, wr_ptr_sync_q, rd_ptr_q and data_o use separate asynchronous reset controls, so an independent reset can make the receiving FIFO state disagree with the pointer crossing.
author: gpt-5.6-luna

provenance.adaptation: Reduced the asynchronous FIFO to write and read pointers, one pointer crossing, and one data output register.

mutation.description: Assigned the data register an independent asynchronous reset domain instead of coordinating it with the pointer state.

labels.by: claude-sonnet (blind second labeller, design and constraints only)
labels.note: data_o on separate reset rst_data_ni is loaded under pointer state in rst_rd_ni domain; independent reset corrupts FIFO consistency.
